en: And so the Chinese premier has been recently cautioning the provincial governors, stop building so many data centers.

speaker: Unknown
en: Because this is now the new thing, it was battery plants, it was solar cell manufacturing, and for a while, 40 years ago, it was hydroelectric dams.

speaker: Unknown
en: So China has a history of consumers underspending and regional and central governments overspending, and which led to massive investment in real estate and ghost cities.

speaker: Unknown
en: Which they, I mean, they definitely shook a little bit, but they didn't crumble from it, which is instructive.
